legend: Bessie and the cows are playing with sequences and need your help. They start with a sequence, initially containing just the number 0, and perform n operations. Each operation is one of the following:
Add the integer xi to the first ai elements of the sequence.
Append an integer ki to the end of the sequence. (And hence the size of the sequence increases by 1)
Remove the last element of the sequence. So, the size of the sequence decreases by one. Note, that this operation can only be done if there are at least two elements in the sequence.
After each operation, the cows would like to know the average of all the numbers in the sequence. Help them!
input: The first line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·105) — the number of operations. The next n lines describe the operations. Each line will start with an integer ti (1 ≤ ti ≤ 3), denoting the type of the operation (see above). If ti = 1, it will be followed by two integers ai, xi (|xi| ≤ 103; 1 ≤ ai). If ti = 2, it will be followed by a single integer ki (|ki| ≤ 103). If ti = 3, it will not be followed by anything.
It is guaranteed that all operations are correct (don't touch nonexistent elements) and that there will always be at least one element in the sequence.
output: Output n lines each containing the average of the numbers in the sequence after the corresponding operation.
The answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error doesn't exceed 10 - 6.
note: In the second sample, the sequence becomes ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fb5aaaa5dc516fe540cef52fd153768bfdb941c8.png)

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 2·105），表示操作次数。接下来的 n 行描述这些操作。每行以一个整数 ti（1 ≤ ti ≤ 3）开头，表示操作类型（见上文）。如果 ti = 1，接下来会有两个整数 ai、xi（|xi| ≤ 103；1 ≤ ai）。如果 ti = 2，接下来会有一个整数 ki（|ki| ≤ 103）。如果 ti = 3，则后面不会有任何内容。
保证所有操作都是正确的（不会操作不存在的元素），并且序列中始终至少有一个元素。

output.ai: 输出 n 行，每行包含执行相应操作后序列中各个数字的平均值。
如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10 - 6，则会被认为正确。

note.ai: 在第二个样例中，序列变为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fb5aaaa5dc516fe540cef52fd153768bfdb941c8.png)

legend.ai: Bessie 和奶牛正在玩序列游戏，需要你的帮助。她们从一个序列开始，该序列初始时只包含数字 0，并进行 n 次操作。每次操作为以下操作之一：
将整数 xi 加到序列的前 ai 个元素上。
将整数 ki 追加到序列末尾。（因此，序列长度增加 1）
移除序列的最后一个元素。因此，序列长度减少 1。注意，只有当序列中至少有两个元素时，才能进行此操作。
每次操作后，奶牛们都想知道序列中所有数字的平均值。请帮助她们！
